summary.text: Scott Stadthagen, a Republican, has represented District 9 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2018 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists him as Republican Party of Alabama chair since March 7, 2026; he served as House Majority Leader from January 2023 until stepping down from House leadership in February 2026.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of West Alabama and has worked as a custom home builder, including as owner of Hagen Homes Incorporated.
